name: web-authoring
description: Drag-and-drop media, bilingual navigation and content linting for the injoon5/web content tree.

webAuthoring.contentRoot.markdownDescription: Workspace-relative root of the content tree. Files are expected at `<contentRoot>/<kind>/<lang>/<slug>.md`.

webAuthoring.staticRoot.markdownDescription: Workspace-relative folder served at `/`. Dropped media lands under here, and every `/...` URL in a post is resolved against it.

webAuthoring.languages.description: Language folders under each content kind, in the order the counterpart command cycles through them.

webAuthoring.assetFolders.markdownDescription: Where media for a given content kind is filed, relative to `#webAuthoring.staticRoot#`. `{slug}` and `{kind}` are substituted. Both languages of a post share one folder.

webAuthoring.fallbackAssetFolder.markdownDescription: Used for markdown files outside the content tree, where `{slug}` is the file's own name.

enumDescriptions: Keep a descriptive filename, but replace camera and screenshot names with <slug>-NN.
webAuthoring.naming.description: How a dropped file is named inside its asset folder.

enumDescriptions: Copy every dropped file byte for byte.
Only convert formats browsers cannot render (HEIC/HEIF/TIFF).
Also re-encode and downscale ordinary images on drop.
webAuthoring.transcode.markdownDescription: The repo already compresses images at build time (`npm run optimize-images`), so the default only converts what a browser could not display at all.

webAuthoring.transcodeTarget.description: Output format when a file is transcoded.

webAuthoring.maxWidth.description: Bounding box applied when transcoding. 0 disables resizing.

webAuthoring.altTextPlaceholder.description: Insert alt text as a snippet tab stop so it is filled in before anything else.

webAuthoring.videoComponent.description: Component inserted for a dropped video. Its import is spliced into the file's instance <script> block.

webAuthoring.statusBar.description: Show the kind, slug and available translations of the open content file.

webAuthoring.diagnostics.enabled.description: Lint content files for broken media links, unbalanced gallery fences, frontmatter problems and smart quotes.

webAuthoring.diagnostics.requireAltText.description: Warn about images with empty alt text.

webAuthoring.diagnostics.missingTranslat.description: Report content that exists in one language only.

webAuthoring.diagnostics.oversizeWidth.description: Warn about referenced images wider than this many pixels. 0 disables the check.
